title: 離子佈植摻雜
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解劑量、射程、損傷及活化，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore dose, range, damage and activation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 佈植目的與輪廓
stages.description: 在「佈植目的與輪廓」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for implant purpose and profiles, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 劑量與濃度
steps.objective: 完成「劑量與濃度」的因果圖，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for separate dose and concentration, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：劑量與濃度。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂積分題：假設一段厚 10 nm 的均勻區濃度為 10^19 cm^-3；先把厚度換成 cm，再求面劑量，並解釋此方盒輪廓不是實際佈植高斯輪廓。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Separate dose and concentration. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical integral: a uniform 10 nm region has concentration 10^19 cm^-3. Convert thickness to cm and compute areal dose; explain why this box profile is not a real implantation Gaussian.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「劑量與濃度」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for separate dose and concentration: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

knowledge.title: 劑量與濃度的原理
knowledge.text: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「離子佈植摻雜」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「劑量與濃度」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：總植入劑量不等於活化載子濃度或接面深度。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：離子佈植摻雜 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「總植入劑量不等於活化載子濃度或接面深度」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Ion implantation doping as the task boundary. After reading “Separate dose and concentration”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Implanted dose is not activated carrier density or junction depth. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Device integration: gate stack to backside power”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Ion implantation doping: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Implanted dose is not activated carrier density or junction depth” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 評估「劑量與濃度」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating separate dose and concentration?
options: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。
峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。
化學摻雜濃度就是活化載子濃度。
optionsEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings.
Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets.
Chemical dopant concentration equals active carrier concentration.
quiz.explanation: 面劑量與體濃度的單位及物理意義不同。 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
quiz.explanationEn: Areal dose and volume concentration have different units and meanings. Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.

steps.title: 摻雜種類
steps.objective: 完成「摻雜種類」的對照表，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for choose dopant roles, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：摻雜種類。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：摻雜元素與晶格佔位共同決定電性作用。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Choose dopant roles. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Dopant species and lattice occupation jointly determine electrical behavior. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「摻雜元素與晶格佔位共同決定電性作用。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Dopant species and lattice occupation jointly determine electrical behavior. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「摻雜種類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for choose dopant roles and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「摻雜種類」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for choose dopant roles: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for read projected range, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：投影射程。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：射程平均值不能代表整個深度分布尾端。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Read projected range. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Mean projected range does not represent the depth-distribution tail. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「射程平均值不能代表整個深度分布尾端。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for read projected range: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 能量與深度
steps.objective: 完成「能量與深度」的故障判別表，把劑量、射程、損傷及活化中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for relate energy and depth, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：能量與深度。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：能量影響深度，也同時影響損傷分布。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Relate energy and depth. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Energy affects both depth and damage distribution. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「能量影響深度，也同時影響損傷分布。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for relate energy and depth and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「能量與深度」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for relate energy and depth: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a measurement plan for define junction depth, connecting relevant limits in dose, range, damage and activation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：接面位置。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：接面需由摻雜輪廓與背景濃度交會判斷。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define junction depth. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Junction depth depends on profile intersection with background doping. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「接面需由摻雜輪廓與背景濃度交會判斷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Interpretation: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

steps.checkEn: Submit the engineering acceptance sheet for set mask-stopping evidence: The sheet needs the principle, two evidence items, open questions and module handoff.

quiz.explanation: 遮罩厚度須考慮射程展寬與薄弱區。 面劑量是深度濃度的積分；相同劑量可透過不同射程展寬形成不同峰值濃度。
quiz.explanationEn: Mask thickness must account for range spread and weak regions. Areal dose is the depth integral of concentration; equal doses can have different peaks because of range spread.
